name: Compiler Tools Hardening v1 (Multi-Pipeline + Cascade Gate + PRD Mandate)
description: Round 2 of compiler tooling improvements after COMP_LEARNS.022 (28ca6bd6, 2026-04-21) shipped the comp-pipescript io blind-spot fixes (FUNC-key writes, prefix cross-ref, rolling-window warn). v1 closes three gaps that surfaced 2026-04-21 to 2026-04-27: (A) comp-pipescript indexes BD gold scripts only — extend to INF gold, BD silver, INF silver, bronze; (B) comp-pipescript postdeps not enforced before split-cascade reruns — AUAGAP.002 missed C_00 because no automatic gate; (C) PRD-authoring compiler mandate inconsistent — ADVI_49EXEC PRD claimed positions.json existed with no producer, caught by manual comp-platinum reverse. v2 addendum (Themes D + E — comp-platinum nested-key indexing + comp-validate failure-mode docs) deferred to ADHC_COMPIL_V2 PRD post-v1.

prds.label: Compiler Tools Hardening v1 PRD (Themes A+B+C)

phase: Phase 0 — PRD authored 2026-04-27 (cc170c00 sibling commit). 3 TOs to issue: ADHC_COMPIL.001 (Theme A multi-pipeline indexing, owner 1.2.0_DS_CompLearns or alt DS, 3-4w), ADHC_COMPIL.002 (Theme B cascade gate, owner 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps, 1-2w), ADHC_COMPIL.003 (Theme C PRD template + protocol, owner 1.0.0_SA_CTO, 1-2w). Optional ADHC_COMPIL.004 (prd-evidence-check.sh lint, gates on .003). All 3 v1 TOs parallelizable.
blocking: Owner assignment for Theme A — 1.2.0_DS_CompLearns is natural choice (COMP_LEARNS.022 expertise) but their primary scope is COMP_LEARNS LLM benchmarking; Andrew to confirm. v1 ships when .001 + .002 + .003 all COMPLETE. v2 (Themes D + E) gates on v1 close per PRD §9.
lane_note: CTO authors Theme C protocol/template/prompt updates. AE 0.7 owns Theme B (.tools/ + gold-dispatch wrappers) and optional Theme C lint. DS 1.2 (CompLearns) is natural Theme A owner given COMP_LEARNS.022 expertise — Andrew to confirm or reassign to 0.4.0_DS_ClientPlatform.
